topic: Lesotho is the only independent state lying entirely above 1,000 m; its lowest point, the junction of the Orange (Senqu) and Makhaleng rivers, is 1,400 m, the highest low point of any country, above Ben Nevis (1,345 m); its highest point is Thabana Ntlenyana (3,482 m); over 80% of the country is above 1,800 m; it is entirely enclaved by South Africa, one of three enclaved states with San Marino and Vatican City.
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

myths.myth: Nepal or Bhutan is the highest country, so it must have the highest low point.
myths.reality: Nepal's lowest point is about 60 m and Bhutan's about 97 m; only Lesotho never drops below 1,000 m.

wiki_geo.notes: Lowest point: junction of the Orange and Makhaleng rivers, 1,400 m, the highest low point of any country; only state entirely above 1,000 m; highest point Thabana Ntlenyana 3,482 m; over 80% above 1,800 m; enclaved by South Africa with San Marino and Vatican City the other enclaved states.

cia.title: Lesotho — Geography
cia.notes: Lowest point: junction of the Orange and Makhaleng Rivers 1,400 m; highest point Thabana Ntlenyana 3,482 m; landlocked, completely surrounded by South Africa.

ifl.title: Just one country on Earth sits entirely above an altitude of 1,000 meters
ifl.notes: Lesotho never dips below 1,400 m; higher than the tallest mountains of the UK, Ireland, the Netherlands and others.

os_ben.title: Ben Nevis height re-measured: 1,345 m
